surface_request: Implement extract_tar_to_path(tar_path: str, dest_path: str) -> bool. Extract a tar archive beneath dest_path and return True on complete success. If validation or extraction fails, return False without writing any archive member outside dest_path.
plan:
SOURCE: Open tar_path and enumerate all member metadata (names, types, link targets); resolve dest_path to a normalized absolute path.
TRUST: Treat every archive member path and link target as untrusted.
SINK: File-system creation of directories, regular files, symbolic links, and hard links under dest_path.
GUARD: Normalize each member's intended extraction path and reject if it lies outside dest_path. Archive extraction may create symbolic-link and hard-link members only when each normalized link target remains inside the destination.
ORDER: Validate every member and link against the guard before extracting any archive content; perform extraction only after validation succeeds for all members.
EFFECT: Return True if all members are fully extracted beneath dest_path; return False if validation or extraction fails, ensuring no member is written outside dest_path.
END_PLAN
